jobs_results.title: Java Developer - Hybrid - SaaS
jobs_results.description:
The Alpega Group is looking for a Java Developer. This role will be part of our Carrier Products Team and to be part of the Product development. This role will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.

WHO ARE WE

Alpega Group is a leading global logistics software company with over 30 years of experience in transportation. The unique collaborative relationship between Alpega TMS and Alpega’s Freight Exchanges elevates the level of experience and service both platforms deliver.

Find more about our clients and services here: https://www.alpegagroup.com/en/freight-exchange/

ABOUT THE ROLE
• You will be responsible (within a small team) for the development phase of the project (end to end), starting from the business analysis up to the release into production (that includes technical analysis, estimate, development, IT testing and bug fixing);
• Design, own, operate and maintain new and current solutions in an Agile environment to continuously deliver value to customers;
• Working as well on... user interfaces and server-side aspects;
• Drive the software quality, security and performance through unit, functional and performance tests;
• Define and estimate technical solutions together with product owner/business analyst;
• Support continuous improvements of the team and the development environment;
• Review code regularly.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN YOU
• Good knowledge & experience: Java 11/JEE/Hibernate/JPA/SQL
• Have fluent Spanish & English
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL Database, Wildfly Server, Webservices, Rest services;
• Linux/unix: ssh, scp, bash and/or other scripting language, debugging
• Debugging capability: jProfiler, tcpdump, system resources.
• Good knowledge about SOLID principles, clean code, DRY.
• Experience using Agile/Scrum methodologies.
• Ability to explain technical concepts and adapt it to the audience;
• You thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced and changing environment;
• Ability to quickly grasp existing solutions (delve into code);
• Nice to have experience with Jenkins/Maven/ActiveMQ, Java/Spring experience for creating business critical SAAS / WEB commercial application platforms, go to cloud (AWS) experience/certification on the AWS platform and Performance/scalability testing.

You will be tested in these competences throughout your selection process.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU
• A competitive salary package, with additional legal benefits focused on your well-being, work flexibility and career growth.
• A permanent contract.
• Gaining experience in the supply chain and logistics, with a dynamic business growth and agile way of working.
• Hybrid working model.
• An international working environment, with over 40 nationalities in the Alpega Team.
• You will be able to impact the future of sustainability in the transportation industry, both for our clients and as well with our internal initiatives.

Learn more about Life at Alpega: https://www.linkedin.com/company/alpegagroup/life/

Our commitment to you

The Alpega Group has 500 collaborators with over 40 nationalities, based in our various locations. We are a global team, with diverse backgrounds, races, faiths, and genders. We commit to ensuring that everyone feels included, has opportunities to learn and grow and is happy at work.

If you require any additional support with your application, reach out to the Talent Acquisition specialist for this position, so we can make arrangements for you.

Good luck with your application! We look forward to hearing from you

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Developer | AWS | 100% Remote
jobs_results.description:
🚀We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 30 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.

🔎 What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to be part of our team working with a highly digitalized top bank customer in US&UK Market. This role will be focused on making service improvements, small service evolutions...

This is a fully remote position for candidates based in Spain

📋 Requirements:
• +6 years of experience as Developer
• Production-grade experience of developing and managing API’s using Java & Springboot. Excellent understanding of SOLID principles, SOA, HTTP and REST.
• Development experience within AWS
• Good knowledge of Gradle.
•... Production experience running microservices on container orchestration architectures.
• Passionate about API testing utilising tools similar to Wiremock, Pact, Postman and Cucumber.
• Good understanding of API authentication and authorisation mechanisms like OAuth.
• Understand the concept of distributed tracing and have some experience working with logging tools
• Basic knowledge of infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipeline management via Jenkins.
• Strong experience in back-end architectural and design patterns.
• Good knowledge of distributed systems at backend with a proven track record in Performance, Scalability, and Resiliency.
• Advanced English level (B2-C1)

📋Desirable requirements:
• Experience with Agile methodologies
• NodeJS experience
• Good knowledge of Maven
• Knowledge using monitoring & logging tools like NewRelic or Logzio to troubleshoot problems in a distributed network of systems.
• Experience with monitoring, alerting and notifications (NewRelic, Grafana, AppDynamics, Logz.io, …) with demonstrable observability implementations.
• Experience with process automation
• Working knowledge with support platform tools (ServiceNow, PagerDuty…)

📋Main tasks and responsibilities:
• Work as part of a SRE cross-functional group of engineers in applying Site Reliability Engineering principles to in-house developed front-end applications.
• Have a clear oversight on how managed systems relate to each other, with autonomy to continuously iterate improvements to achieve highly available, fault tolerant applications.
• Identify, troubleshoot and pre-empt operational issues being able to understand and modify code.
• Preserve the platform health and implement tech compliance
• Drive engineering best practice (e.g, Operational Excellence, Security, Quality, Resilience etc.) and set standards across the team.
• Estimate, scope and plan your work within an agile environment.
• Willingness to be part of a 24/7 on-call rota (paid additionally)

What can we offer?

✈️ 23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!

❤️ Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).

🍴 `Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)

🎓 Free access to several training platforms

🚀 Professional stability and career plans

🚶 UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.

🔗 The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.

🏡 Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)

🎁 UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

If you would like to know more, don’t hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in detail. We are waiting for you

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/x Java Microservicios
jobs_results.description:
En alvatross by SATEC estamos creciendo a un ritmo muy rápido y buscamos reforzar nuestro equipo de desarrollo de la parte back-end.

Somos una corporate venture del grupo SATEC especializada en productos OSS/BSS para operadoras de telecomunicaciones españolas e internacionales. Tenemos una suite de productos de provisión, activación e inventario alineadas con las últimas prácticas de Open Digital Architecture (ODA) y somos el primer vendor de OSS europeo en alcanzar la certificación Gold de Open APIs de TM Forum.

¿Quieres formar parte del equipo de desarrollo de back-end?

Dentro de alvatross, formarás parte del equipo de desarrollo de back-end, participando en:
• Diseño y desarrollo de aplicaciones back-end en microservicios.
• Crear APIs con amplias funcionalidades e interactuar con otras APIs.
• Implementar procesos de integración continua y entrega continua utilizando plataformas estándar (TM Forum).

Sabemos que formamos parte de un sector donde la tecnología es la base de todo... lo que hacemos. Aquí trabajarás con:
• Lenguaje Java, donde en la parte back hacemos uso de los frameworks Spring/Spring-boot.
• Kubernetes o Docker como orquestadores de contenedores.
• SQL, NoSQL, Oracle, Postegres, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra… Son las bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales de las que más hacemos uso.
• Kafka para lo relacionado con eventos.
• Azure y Amazon Web Services son las plataformas en la nube con las que trabajamos.
• ELK y Grafana, para todo lo relacionado con la observabilidad.

En alvatross by SATEC, apostamos por las personas y creemos firmemente en la innovación. Ponemos a tu alcance un Plan de carrera que adaptarás a tu crecimiento profesional. Al movernos en un entorno internacional, entendemos la importancia de los idiomas y ofrecemos clases gratuitas para tod@s. El teletrabajo es una realidad para nosotr@s, por eso podrás trabajar en remoto 100% o presencialmente en cualquiera de nuestras oficinas. Trabajamos con flexibilidad horaria ya que lo importante es que cada un@ decida que se adapta mejor en su día. Además, en Verano, nos gusta disfrutar las tardes, así que nos hemos decantado por fijar una jornada intensiva que coincide con el calendario escolar
